query: What optimization objective function, decision variables, constraints (cost caps, minimum coverage for top vulnerability percentiles) and solver(s) will we use for shelter placement and transport supports?

response.query: What optimization objective function, decision variables, constraints (cost caps, minimum coverage for top vulnerability percentiles) and solver(s) will we use for shelter placement and transport supports?
response.answer: Objective: Minimize cost while maximizing coverage. Decision variables: Shelter locations and transport routes. Constraints: Cost caps and minimum coverage for top vulnerability percentiles. Solver: Linear programming.

Section 101(b) of the Medicare Access and CHIP Reauthorization Act of 2015 (MACRA) sunset the Medicare EHR Incentive Program for Eligible Professionals, set forth at section 1848(o) of the Act. See CY 2017 Quality Payment Program final rule (81 FR 77018 and 77019) for more information regarding the sunsetting of the Medicare EHR Incentive Program for Eligible Professionals.

Based on data showing that the percent of LTSS expenditures delivered through managed LTSS delivery systems varied between 3 percent and 93 percent in 2019 across all States with managed LTSS, we assume that all States deliver at least some HCBS through fee-for-service delivery systems ( *https://www.medicaid.gov/​medicaid/​long-term-services-supports/​downloads/​ltssexpenditures2019.pdf*).
